title: 第13章 无涯山脉第14章 山壁幻境三阶妖兽
slug: 转世成女开局攻略气运之子
content_zh:
半炷香后，景王府中的歌舞乐师依次退出大殿。
王府正殿大门半遮，从那缝隙之中，还显露出几分萎靡景象。
然而不过片刻，伴随着殿内凄厉的惨叫声。
一个身披锦袍的青年踱步而出，脚下沾染着血迹。
见状，阶下的陈公公连忙摆手，侍卫们鱼贯冲入殿内。
&#34；殿下可尽兴？&#34；老太监佝偻着背递上热帕。
沈离擦着颈侧血痕，不知从哪拿出的鎏金匕首，突然抵住老太监喉结：&#34；我很好奇......&#34；
刀锋游走到他颤抖的眼皮上：&#34；这匕首，怎么躲过搜检的？&#34；
闻言，陈公公顿时感觉头晕目眩，冷汗涔涔。
扑通一下跪倒在地，青玉帽准磕在刀刃上，迸出火星。
“老奴以性命担保！”
&#34；啧。&#34；
早就知道对方是何反应的沈离，突然收刀入鞘。
&#34；我那短命师兄，你处理的......&#34；
&#34；埋在三丈深的化骨潭，老奴亲自盯着。&#34；
不等沈离问完，陈公公连声抢答。
抬眼间，余光刚巧瞥见侍卫抬出两具蒙着白布的女尸。
暗红的血顺着外露的小指滑落，滴落在青石砖上，连成一片。
侍女随从们见怪不怪，开始清理起正殿的每一个角落。
整个流程，十分熟练。

“这里没你什么事了，记得抓紧派人，把那玄阴之体的女人给带回来。”
沈离沉沉说着，随后转身迈步，走回大殿。
身后，陈公公拱手称诺，准备连忙下去安排此事。
回到殿中的沈离，自顾自的给自己倒上一杯酒水。
望着空荡荡的大殿，嘴角扯出一丝笑来。
他不明白，修炼资源，身份地位......
他把能给的都给了，姐妹俩为什么还要找死。
扯开身上的蟒袍，看着胸口那道深可见骨的血痕，沈离掌心发力，将那鎏金匕首揉作一团。
“王羽啊王羽，死了也不安生！”
心中默念着，他随手一招，兵器架上一柄青铜古剑飞入手中。
古剑之上，魔气腾腾！
......
雄鸡一唱天下白，一日清晨之际，对于武者而言，是最佳的修炼时段。
但可惜，方玉凝醒来时，早已是日上三竿。
坐在梳妆镜前，看着系统面板的信息，她小脸上写满了无奈。
小嘴嘟着，满腹怨言。
“不是，这对嘛？”
content_en:
After half a stick of incense, the singing and dancing musicians in Prince Jing's mansion exited the hall one by one.
The main door of the palace was half-covered, and through the gap, a somewhat dejected scene could be seen.
However, within just a moment, there was a shrill scream in the palace.
A young man wearing a brocade robe walked out, his feet stained with blood.
Seeing this, Eunuch Chen at the bottom of the steps quickly waved his hand, and the guards filed into the hall.
"How can you enjoy yourself, Your Highness? "The old eunuch handed over the hot handkerchief with his hunched back.
Shen Li wiped the blood on the side of his neck. He took out the gilt dagger from somewhere and suddenly pressed it against the old eunuch's Adam's apple: "I'm very curious..."
The blade of the knife came to his trembling eyelids: "How did this dagger escape inspection?" "
Hearing this, Eunuch Chen suddenly felt dizzy and broke into a cold sweat.
He fell to his knees with a plop, and his sapphire hat hit the blade of the knife, sparks bursting out.
"Old slave guarantees it with his life!"
"Tsk. "
Shen Li, who already knew how the other party would react, suddenly sheathed his sword.
"My short-lived senior brother, you handled it..."
"Buried in the Bone Transformation Pond three feet deep, the old slave watched it personally. "
Before Shen Li could finish asking, Eunuch Chen rushed to answer.
When he raised his eyes, he happened to catch a glimpse of the guards carrying out two female corpses covered with white cloth.
Dark red blood slid down the exposed little finger and dripped onto the bluestone tiles, forming a continuous patch.
The maids and attendants were not surprised and began to clean every corner of the main hall.
The whole process was very skillful.
"You have nothing to do here. Remember to send someone quickly to bring back the woman with the Xuanyin body."
Shen Li said solemnly, then turned around and walked back to the main hall.
Behind him, Eunuch Chen handed over his hand and promised to go down quickly to arrange the matter.
When Shen Li returned to the palace, he poured himself a glass of wine.
Looking at the empty hall, a smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
He doesn't understand, cultivation resources, status...
He gave everything he could, so why did the sisters seek death?
Pulling off the python robe on his body and looking at the blood mark on his chest that was so deep that he could see the bones, Shen Li used his palms to crumple the gilded dagger into a ball.
"Wang Yu, Wang Yu, I can't live even if I die!"
Thinking silently in his mind, he made a casual move, and an ancient bronze sword from the weapon rack flew into his hand.
Above the ancient sword, demonic aura is rising!
...
When the rooster sings, the whole world becomes white. Early in the morning is the best time for warriors to practice.
But unfortunately, when Fang Yuning woke up, it was already three o'clock in the morning.
Sitting in front of the dressing mirror, looking at the information on the system panel, her face was full of helplessness.
The little mouth was pouting, full of complaints.
"No, is this right?"
